assign.request: LOOKS lab: appearance recipes for column pages at core/Page/overview/columns/examples/looks/ — backgrounds, padding, seams+scrollbars
steps: read spec + columns doc + finder model

log.msg: verdict backgrounds: a column never inherits its neighbour background - naming both sides the same token (--surface/--surface) reads as one connected surface; naming just one side makes the seam a real edge, worst at --surface beside ambient --wash. --tint is nearly invisible against --wash at this theme contrast - barely a finding on its own.

verdict padding: grid auto gap pad vs bare grid auto correctly toggles the swatches own gap/edge inset, but page-column-prose (Page.class.js column()) always wraps a columns content in its own 0.7em/0.9em padding regardless - so flush is flush against the prose wrapper, never truly flush against the column boundary itself. A real edge-to-edge grid needs a path that skips page-column-prose, which column() does not expose yet.

verdict scrollbars: an accidental scrollbar (broken - the whole column body overflows) lands its native scrollbar right on the border-inline-end hairline and doubles the seam; the fix is a bounded, inset sub-region (looks-scroll, max-height + padding-inline-end) so the columns own edge never carries the overflow. Short, matched-background content (connected) needs no decision at all - the head fill (--wash) and one hairline are the whole seam.

verified headless 1280/1920/3440 (throwaway server, own port, never the shared :80 instance) - zero console errors on all three recipe pages and the index; zero unintended overflow. examples/grids/ 404s seen mid-run were the concurrent sibling task building that subtree, confirmed present even on unrelated /overview/columns/ - not mine, not touched.

assign.now: verified headless, screenshots taken, logging verdicts

assign.outcome:
**Three LOOKS recipes shipped** — real `columns()` trees, one appearance variable each, zero console errors at 1280/1920/3440.

- [Backgrounds](/framework/core/Page/overview/columns/examples/looks/backgrounds/) — --wash vs --tint vs --surface, parent/child match. Verdict: a column never inherits its neighbour, --tint barely reads against --wash, --surface beside ambient wash is a real edge.
- [Padding](/framework/core/Page/overview/columns/examples/looks/padding/) — `grid auto gap pad` vs bare `grid auto`. Verdict: flush is flush against `page-column-prose`, not the column boundary itself — column() has no path around that wrapper yet.
- [Seams + scrollbars](/framework/core/Page/overview/columns/examples/looks/scrollbars/) — broken (whole-column scroll on the border hairline) vs a bounded inset `.looks-scroll` region vs a short matched-background pair. Verdict: an accidental scrollbar doubles the seam; a deliberate inset region keeps it one hairline.
